title: Prototipista
description:

title: Us immigration paralegal (employment based petitions)
description:
Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Type: Full-Time

Company Description

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform founded by immigrants, for immigrants, dedicated to supporting U. S. mobility needs for technologists, artists, and skilled professionals. The company's mission is to simplify the immigration process, making it accessible and efficient for individuals and businesses alike. With innovative solutions and expertise, Beyond Border provides comprehensive support throughout the immigration journey to help clients achieve their goals. Learn more about their services at Beyond Border Global.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Immigration Paralegal specializing in U. S. Employment-Based Petitions. The responsibilities include assisting with the preparation and submission of employment-based visa petitions and other immigration filings, conducting research on immigration law and policies, reviewing and organizing legal documents, and collaborating with attorneys and clients to ensure compliance. The candidate will also provide ongoing support to clients, maintain case management systems, and monitor deadlines and case progress.

Qualifications 3+ years of US O1, EB1, EB2 petition experience with a successful track record of approvals is a must. Strong knowledge of Law, Immigration Law, and Immigration Issues Experience with Visas and Employment-Based Immigration Processes Proficiency in Legal Document Preparation and detail-oriented case management Exceptional organizational, time-management, and written communication skills Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment Bachelor’s degree or paralegal certification; prior experience in immigration law is highly preferred

title: Community manager - roboneo brazil
description:
Why We Need You:

Robo Neo ( is landing in Brazil, and we're building a creator community that can turn AI-powered imagination into reality. As our Community Manager, you'll be the one finding brilliant creators, getting them hooked on our tools, and fueling a movement that drives real user growth. This isn't managing an existing group — you'll build it from scratch in one of the most explosive markets for generative AI video. You'll work closely with product, marketing, and growth teams across different countries, and pick up skills that are only going to get more valuable. If you love AI, content, and the chaos of building something new, this is your spot.

What You'll Do:

· Scout and win over top AI creators across Brazil — identify talented voices, reach out, and get them excited about what Robo Neo can do;

· Own the relationship from first hello to long-term partnership — run interviews, onboard new creators, and keep the vibe strong with the people who matter most;

· Be the bridge between the community and our product — gather feedback, spot patterns, and help creators solve their real challenges with Robo Neo;

· Build and run training that actually helps — design educational flows, share pro tips, and level up the quality of content the community puts out;

· Keep a finger on the pulse with data — track community health every week, pull reports, and turn numbers into smarter moves that boost engagement.

Who You Are:

· You've got 1+ years of hands-on experience in community management, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or something similar;

· Portuguese is your native language (or C1+) and you breathe Brazilian internet culture — you know where creators hang out, what formats fly, and what feels fake a mile away;

· You're genuinely curious about AI and content creation — you'd jump at the chance to geek out over new tools and become a product expert;

· You're a people person for real — you enjoy connecting with creators, reading what makes them tick, and building relationships that last beyond a DM;

· Numbers don't scare you — you're comfortable digging into metrics to see what's working, what's not, and turning those insights into action;

· You're a self-starter who builds things from zero — you don't wait for a manual, you figure it out and make it happen in a fast, scrappy environment.

Even Better If You...

· You've already worked with creator or UGC communities in video or photo content;

· You've played around with AI content generation tools and know what "good" looks like;

· English proficiency is a plus.

title: Finance & accounting manager - ai-enabled
description:
Emperor Rentals is a U. S. vacation-rental and real-estate business seeking a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager based in Brazil for a full-time remote position, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time. You will work with our Portuguese-speaking team and communicate clearly in English with U. S. management and our external accountant.

This is a very hands-on individual-contributor role. You will personally perform day-to-day bookkeeping and financial housekeeping: clean up transactions, organize receipts, reconcile accounts, prepare owner statements, and produce recurring reports. You will own follow-through from source documents to accurate books and completed reporting. You will also improve these financial workflows using AI.

COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE

USD $250 per week. Required schedule: FULL-TIME, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern Time (New York time, following Eastern daylight-saving changes). You must be available for this fixed schedule; general time-zone overlap is not sufficient. Confirm your availability and acceptance of this weekly budget in your proposal. Long-term collaboration is intended, subject to performance and mutual agreement.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Daily Quick Books Online bookkeeping across separate legal entities: bank/card feeds, accurate categories, property classes, receipts, and an aged exception list.

- Bank and credit-card reconciliations to actual statements, with every difference explained and supporting documents retained.

- Owner Rez accounting: reconcile property expenses and owner statements to Quick Books, distinguish reimbursements from service income, and prepare weekly property-management transfer schedules for approval.

- Keep guest/owner trust funds, operating cash, intercompany transfers, owner distributions, and business income correctly separated.

- Reconcile Airbnb, Vrbo, , Stripe and other payouts, fees, commissions, refunds and chargebacks to bookings and bank deposits.

- Prepare monthly owner statements and property-level reports, apply review corrections promptly, and track completion through final approval.

- Support weekly payroll and contractor-payment reconciliation across time/work records, payment-provider records and the bank, including fees and failed or duplicate payments.

- Retrieve mortgage and utility support, prepare principal/interest/escrow allocations, and maintain property-specific records.

- Deliver monthly P& L, balance-sheet support, reconciliation schedules and a clear list of unresolved items. Support W-9/1099 preparation under the external accountant's approved instructions.

AI-ASSISTED ACCOUNTING

- Use approved AI tools to help extract invoice data, propose transaction classifications, compare exports, investigate differences, draft reports and document procedures.

- Build repeatable spreadsheet and AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

- Verify every AI-generated calculation, classification and proposed entry against source documents. Keep a clear audit trail and follow company data-access policies.

- Retain personal responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of the books, and obtain required approval before posting adjustments or releasing payments.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- At least 3 years of hands-on U. S. bookkeeping/accounting and Quick Books Online, with ownership of reconciliations, monthly close and financial reporting.

- Either practical experience using AI tools in finance/accounting, OR a strong willingness to learn and consistently use AI in our financial workflows. Prior AI expertise is not required; careful verification, curiosity and adoption of our tools are required.

- Strong bank reconciliation, double-entry accounting, balance-sheet cleanup and multi-entity experience.

- Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling large exports.

- Professional Portuguese and strong written/spoken English. Based in Brazil for team collaboration and working-hour alignment.

- Ability to spot duplicates, missing receipts, incorrect periods, wrong properties and unsupported classifications without waiting for the owner to find them.

- Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and willingness to use Hubstaff for agreed work-time reporting.

STRONGLY PREFERRED

Property management, vacation rentals, real estate or trust/owner accounting; Owner Rez; OTA/Stripe payout reconciliation; Quick Books Pro Advisor certification; familiarity with Slack, Notion, Operto or similar operations tools. An accounting degree is welcome.

HOW WE DEFINE GOOD WORK

Accurate reconciliations, clear evidence and dependable completion dates. Review new bank-feed items each business day and process supported items within one business day where possible. Escalate missing information with an owner and due date. Reconcile before declaring work complete. Flag unclear instructions, explain accounting implications, document decisions and improve repetitive workflows. Payment release and tax decisions remain subject to management/accountant approval.

TO APPLY

1. Describe your U. S. Quick Books and property-management experience, including the number of entities/accounts you managed.

2. Explain how you would handle a property repair paid by Operations and later reimbursed from owner funds without double-counting income.

3. Describe a bookkeeping error you discovered, how you proved it and how you prevented recurrence.

4. Explain your monthly-close checklist and how you track missing receipts and unresolved differences.

5. Describe how you currently use AI, or confirm your willingness to learn and use AI in our financial workflows. Explain how you would check its output for accuracy.

6. Confirm your location in Brazil, English/Portuguese proficiency, availability for the full-time Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U. S. Eastern schedule, and acceptance of USD $250 per week.

Please share only anonymized examples with no client financial details. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a separately agreed paid practical exercise using sample data. We value sound judgment, careful work and clear communication.

title: Partnerships manager
description:
Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Supply Partnership

You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.

Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.

That's where you come in.

The Role — In Plain English

You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.

This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.

Your week might look like this:

Monday: Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates. Tuesday: Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides. Wednesday: Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high-value partner launch. Thursday: Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week. Friday: Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy-in. Start executing.

You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.

What Makes This Different

Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.

You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.

Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.

You Might Be Right For This If... You have 2+ years in partnerships, supply ops, business operations, or client-facing roles — ideally in Saa S, Ad Tech, HR Tech, or recruitment advertising You've actually negotiated a deal, not just "supported" one. You know what it feels like to own a number. You're the person who looks at a messy spreadsheet and sees a pattern everyone else missed You can context-switch between a partner call, a data pull, and a strategy doc without losing momentum Process inefficiency physically bothers you. You automate things before anyone asks you to. You're comfortable in ambiguity — startup speed doesn't stress you, it sharpens you

What You'll Get Real ownership: Commercial decisions, partner relationships, and operational outcomes — yours from day one Leadership exposure: Work directly with CXOs and cross-functional leads across Product, Tech, Sales, and Client Success Growth trajectory: Previous hires in this function have built entirely new capabilities within Joveo's supply ecosystem Compensation: Among the most competitive in India, including stock options Global scope: Partners and markets that span continents — not a single-geography desk job

If you'd rather build the partnership playbook than follow one — we should talk.

Joveo. Where AI meets the future of work.

Verification Lifecycle Ownership Own and execute the complete verification lifecycle from system-level concept through tape-out and post-silicon support. Develop and execute verification strategies for digital power IPs. Define verification environments, tools, and testing methodologies.

Testbench Methodology Development Develop pre-silicon test plans for digital power IPs. Build and maintain verification testbenches using System Verilog UVM methodology. Develop functional coverage models and assertion-based verification. Perform formal verification activities including property checking. Implement and support power-aware verification flows using UPF .

Design Analysis Collaboration Collaborate with product designers to understand functionality and protocol requirements. Review product designs to identify potential failure points. Develop verification methodologies based on design requirements and risk areas.

Automation Process Improvement Develop automation solutions to improve verification efficiency. Optimize testing processes and verification workflows. Plan and execute structured test sequences and validation activities.

Quality Documentation Conduct quality control inspections and verification sign-off activities. Prepare final test procedures and documentation. Support training and knowledge sharing with QC teams.

Mandatory Requirements Strong experience in IC verification, particularly digital verification. Experience with System Verilog and UVM-based verification methodologies . Experience developing verification testbenches and coverage models. Experience with assertion-based verification and formal verification concepts. Understanding of pre-silicon verification processes. Experience collaborating with IC design teams. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with UPF power-aware verification flows . Experience with digital power IP verification. Experience developing verification automation frameworks. Experience supporting tape-out and post-silicon validation activities.

Ensino médio completo; Experiência mínima comprovada de 6 anos como Operador de Extrusora; Experiência em extrusoras tipo balão, preferencialmente em equipamentos Mono e Coex; Domínio do processo de extrusão de filmes em PEBD, PEBDL e PEAD; Experiência com matérias-primas virgens e recicladas; Conhecimento em setup, regulagem e partida de máquinas; Conhecimento em controle de espessura e estabilidade do balão; Domínio dos parâmetros do processo de extrusão; Capacidade para identificar e corrigir desvios durante a produção; Perfil proativo, responsável e comprometido com qualidade, segurança, produtividade e redução de perdas; Organização, atenção e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

Oportunidade de aplicar e ampliar seus conhecimentos técnicos; Ambiente de trabalho próximo e colaborativo; Possibilidade de crescimento por desempenho, dedicação e excelência; Participação direta na melhoria dos processos e nos resultados da empresa; Empresa comprometida com qualidade, segurança e responsabilidade ambiental; Valorização de profissionais experientes, responsáveis e comprometidos.

Nome do Cargo: Analista Pleno de Planejamento Financeiro (FP& A)

Local: Vila Olímpia, SP - Híbrido 3x2

Reporta-se para: Coordenador de Planejamento Financeiro

Como Analista Pleno de Planejamento Financeiro (FP& A), você será responsável por conduzir o planejamento e as análises financeiras (budget, forecast e fechamento), garantindo a consolidação e qualidade das informações. Atuará na análise de margens, preço/volume/mix e na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, apoiando a tomada de decisão e interagindo com diferentes áreas do negócio.

Responsabilidades

Apoiar a execução do fechamento gerencial mensal. Consolidar e validar informações de P& L, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa. Preparar relatórios gerenciais e materiais para Diretoria, CFO, Corporate e comitês. Apoiar os processos de forecast, estimativas e budget. Consolidar informações das áreas e unidades de negócio, realizando cargas, validações e conciliações nos sistemas corporativos. Analisar variações de Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast vs. Prior Year e investigar divergências antes do reporte. Atualizar modelos financeiros, bases de dados, relatórios, apresentações e dashboards em Power BI. Garantir organização, integridade, rastreabilidade e documentação das informações financeiras. Acompanhar o calendário de fechamento, forecast e budget, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos. Identificar oportunidades de automação, simplificação e melhoria dos processos de reporting. Preparar análises para apoiar o Coordenador de FP& A e as áreas de negócio. Traduzir variações financeiras, riscos e oportunidades em explicações objetivas e apoiar a validação de premissas e planos de ação.

Requisitos

Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas Experiência em FP& A, Reporting ou áreas relacionadas Conhecimento das principais demonstrações financeiras Experiência com fechamento gerencial, consolidação de informações ou análise de variações Excel avançado e conhecimento de Power BI Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com prazos recorrentes Inglês avançado

Diferenciais

Experiência anterior em Auditoria, Contabilidade ou Controladoria Formação em Ciências Contábeis e conhecimento de controles internos e processos contábeis Conhecimento de SAP, Hyperion, SAC, One Stream ou sistemas similares Experiência com Power Query, Power Pivot, automações ou ferramentas de tratamento de dados Aplicação prática de IA em análises, automações e produtividade financeira

Liderar tecnicamente projetos de automação, modernização tecnológica e transformação digital, conduzindo diagnósticos de falhas críticas, análises de desempenho dos sistemas de controle, gestão de riscos, padronização de soluções e melhoria contínua dos ativos industriais, contribuindo para o aumento da estabilidade operacional, produtividade, disponibilidade física, eficiência dos processos, redução de custos, sustentabilidade, competitividade e inovação das operações.

Liderar tecnicamente projetos de automação, modernização tecnológica e transformação digital, garantindo atendimento aos requisitos técnicos, operacionais, financeiros, de prazo, escopo, segurança e retorno para o negócio. Atuar como referência técnica no planejamento e execução de paradas programadas e de manutenção, avaliando riscos relacionados à automação, instrumentação e controle e propondo soluções que assegurem a continuidade operacional. Desenvolver e implantar soluções de monitoramento on-line, alarmes inteligentes, dashboards, indicadores, plataformas de dados industriais e análises preditivas para suporte à tomada de decisão e melhoria do desempenho operacional. Avaliar tecnicamente equipamentos, instrumentos, sistemas, projetos de engenharia e fornecedores, elaborando estudos, pareceres, memórias de cálculo, especificações e recomendações para aquisição, implantação, modernização e melhorias. Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos por meio da automação, instrumentação, digitalização e novas tecnologias, contribuindo para redução de perdas, aumento da eficiência energética, disponibilidade dos ativos e competitividade operacional. Desenvolver análises de desempenho das malhas de controle, propondo ajustes de sintonia, melhorias das estratégias de controle, racionalização de alarmes e otimização dos processos. Implantar soluções de monitoramento preditivo, detecção de anomalias, gatilhos, níveis de alerta e análises de desempenho de equipamentos, processos e sistemas de controle utilizando dados industriais. title: Especialista de geração de energia e utilidades
description:
Somos Atvos!

Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.

Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:

#Vem Pra Atvos

Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.

Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Geração de Energia e Utilidades com sólida experiência em sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades industriais, perfil técnico, analítico e visão corporativa. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por atuar de forma estratégica na gestão técnica dos sistemas de geração de energia, vapor e utilidades, contribuindo para a eficiência, confiabilidade, segurança e melhoria contínua dos processos.

A posição terá atuação corporativa, promovendo a padronização de práticas e soluções técnicas entre as unidades, desenvolvendo padrões e especificações e apoiando a disseminação de conhecimentos e melhores práticas. Espera-se capacidade para estabelecer interface com diferentes áreas da organização, incluindo o time Comercial, traduzindo necessidades técnicas em soluções e contribuindo para decisões estratégicas relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Atuar na gestão técnica dos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades: acompanhar e apoiar a operação dos sistemas de geração de energia, geração de vapor e demais utilidades industriais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria de desempenho, eficiência e confiabilidade. Garantir a segurança e confiabilidade dos processos: atuar na identificação e mitigação de riscos relacionados aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades, contribuindo para a segurança dos processos e a confiabilidade dos ativos. Desenvolver e implementar padrões técnicos: elaborar, revisar e implementar padrões, especificações técnicas, editais e melhores práticas relacionadas aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades, promovendo maior padronização entre as unidades. Otimizar o desempenho energético: analisar balanços de energia, identificar oportunidades de redução de perdas e otimização do consumo e contribuir para a melhoria contínua da eficiência dos sistemas de geração. Atuar na gestão de caldeiras e geração de vapor: acompanhar aspectos relacionados ao projeto, operação e desempenho de caldeiras, especialmente sistemas de geração de vapor a partir de biomassa. Acompanhar sistemas de tratamento de água e balanço hídrico: atuar na avaliação e otimização dos processos de tratamento de água em torres e caldeiras, contribuindo para a melhoria do balanço hídrico e da eficiência operacional. Promover a integração e padronização entre unidades: identificar sinergias, compartilhar boas práticas e apoiar a implementação de soluções técnicas comuns entre as diferentes unidades da companhia. Atuar de forma corporativa e estratégica: estabelecer interface com áreas técnicas, operacionais e corporativas, incluindo o time Comercial, apoiando análises e decisões relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades. Desenvolver conhecimento e capacitar equipes: disseminar conhecimento técnico, apoiar a capacitação das equipes e promover a evolução das práticas relacionadas à geração de energia e utilidades.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Química ou Engenharia de Produção Mecânica. Experiência em engenharia, geração de energia e/ou utilidades industriais. Experiência sólida em sistemas de geração de energia, sendo este o principal foco da posição. Conhecimento em geração de vapor e utilidades industriais. Conhecimento em caldeiras de biomassa, incluindo projeto e operação. Conhecimento em balanço de energia e eficiência energética. Conhecimento em segurança de processos e confiabilidade de ativos. Conhecimento em tratamento de água em torres e caldeiras. Experiência ou conhecimento em otimização e melhoria do balanço hídrico. Conhecimento de padrões técnicos, normas e melhores práticas aplicáveis aos sistemas de geração de energia e utilidades. Experiência no desenvolvimento e implementação de padrões técnicos e especificações. Capacidade de atuação em ambiente corporativo e de interação com diferentes áreas e stakeholders. Perfil analítico, estratégico, colaborativo e com forte capacidade de comunicação e influência.

Diferenciais:

Experiência em ambientes industriais de grande porte, especialmente energia, agronegócio, açúcar e etanol, papel e celulose, química ou outros segmentos com geração própria de energia. Vivência em geração de energia a partir de biomassa. Experiência em atuação corporativa com interface entre diferentes unidades industriais. Conhecimento em projetos de otimização energética e melhoria de eficiência de sistemas de geração. Experiência na definição de padrões, especificações técnicas e contratação de soluções/serviços técnicos. Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas unidades e necessidade de padronização de processos e melhores práticas.

Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.

title: Engenheiro de pré-vendas
description:
Job Title: Pre-Sales Engineer (Lat Am)

Location: Remote (Based in/near São Paulo, Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-time, Long-term Independent Contractor

Remuneration: USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month (Gross, based on experience)

About Wayzim

Wayzim Technology Co., Ltd. ( is a leading global provider of intelligent logistics automation solutions. We specialize in advanced sorting systems, conveyor technologies, and smart warehouse infrastructure, serving top e-commerce, express delivery, and 3 PL leaders worldwide.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive, fast-learning Pre-Sales Engineer based in the São Paulo area to serve as a key technical bridge between our Latin America sales team, regional clients, and HQ mechanical design engineers in China.

In this role, you will lead client technical communications, develop CAD solution layouts, and participate in hands-on site visits across Latin America to help drive business expansion in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & CAD Layouts: Collaborate closely with China-based mechanical engineers and local sales teams to translate client requirements into technical proposals and accurate 2 D/3 D CAD layouts. Client Engagement: Join technical discussions, client meetings, and proposal presentations across Latin America to address technical inquiries and clarify scope. On-Site Alignment & Training: Travel to project sites (in Brazil and other Lat Am countries) for site surveys, dimensional verification, and hands-on training on Wayzim equipment. Continuous Learning: Actively master Wayzim's equipment specifications, mechanical structures, and automation workflows to independently drive regional pre-sales technical support.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or related engineering fields. Work Experience: Up to 5 years of experience in pre-sales technical support, mechanical design, or project engineering (promising junior candidates are welcome). Software Skills: Proficient in Auto CAD; familiarity with 3 D modeling software (e.g., Solid Works) is a plus. Language Skills: English: Fluent (written & spoken, required for daily communication with headquarters). Spanish: Conversational to fluent (strong advantage for regional project coverage). Portuguese: Native or fluent. Location & Mobility: Based in or near São Paulo, Brazil. Must hold a valid passport and be willing to travel internationally across Latin America for site visits and equipment training. Key Traits: High self-motivation, strong independent learning capability, and excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

What We Offer

Competitive compensation package (USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month). Flexible remote work model with travel opportunities across Latin America. Direct exposure to cutting-edge global logistics automation technology and large-scale industrial projects.

title: Senior product designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2 C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We’re looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects. Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI. Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs. Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users. Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes. Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration. Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

5+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces. Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping). Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed. Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff. Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil. Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments. Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora Strong Local Digital Product Companies: Quinto Andar, i Food, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo Strong Design Consultancies: Work& Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package Model: PJ Compensation: aggressive salary Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Product analyst - vmake · brazil
description:
Why We Need You

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.

What You’ll Do Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.

Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within Saa S, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Program manager
description:
Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility?

Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere.

Main missions:

Manages and delivers the project (OP and Customer) objectives and deliverables. Responsible for the project profitability Manages the complete development budget and cash flow for the entire project. Delivers a non-event launch of the project into production Represents OP at the customer and represents the customer in OP Promote EHS and quality requirements internally and externally Project Definition Ensures the OPTIMAP Project plan and total development budget is in accordance with the agreed Customer Statement of Work and validated project scope. Leads the core team member's OPTIMAP work packages and their agreed development budgets, in agreement with the project objectives and the project scope Establishes and manages the master project timing plan and consolidates negotiated planning of each core team member ensuring it conforms to the customer and OPTIMAP timing plans Responsible for the profitability of the project and sets the core team members' targets to work towards in line with the project objectives. (Development hours, PRU, investments, cash flow, Costs of Non-Quality). Follows and applies the direction of the division cascaded by the Program director. At the end of the project assesses the status against the original project objectives and feeds back lessons learned. Actions management / Reporting / Risks In line with the OPTIMAP Project Plan, consolidates the global project status and ensures that the core teams are accountable for their status for the deliverables completion in the division Information Systems. Manages and identifies deviations from the planned Project Plan and validates the actions proposed by the core team members to realign. Responsible for organizing project meetings, project reviews and end of phase reviews with all core team members to review project status and project action plan follow-up. Prepares and presents the gateway reports to the OPTIMAP committee and, in anticipation of the gate event, issues the gate validation report. Consolidates the threats and opportunities of each department, prioritizes and manages the action plan to respond to the risks throughout the project phases. Responsible for the financial control / reporting of the project budget using the standard BG tools to consolidate and reporting cash flow and profitability to program reviews. Split of the project development budget by department and delegation to the core team members for their financial control / reporting (excluding payment/expenditure authorization). Manages the scope change (internal / external) process and ensures the project budget is updated (hours, investment and production costs). Manages project development expenditure versus the planned budget, identifies any deviation (hours, investments and production costs), and takes appropriate actions to realign. Manages the project cash flow, including tooling and other costs. Only project team members can authorize payment to suppliers respecting OPs procedures and terms. Responsible for ensuring the contribution and actions of all project team members to achieve a non-event launch. Challenges that the optimum technical and manufacturing solutions / choices are made by the project team to meet the design to cost project objectives. Provides periodic reporting to the program director, plant director, department managers and sales director highlighting the key project progress and risks through the program review process. Follows the project reporting of each core team member to manage the escalation process of issues and risks and the achievement of their project actions. Team / people Ensures the coordination of the project team, communication management, project meeting organization, conflict resolution and building an effective team. Ensures the project team applies the methodology of development - OPTIMAP through adequate division Information Systems In line with the project development budget identifies the resource needs, skills and locations to meet the project objectives. Contributes to the annual assessment process of the core team members. Responsible to ensure the project team apply company standards and best practices as defined by each department to maximise the productivity of the development budget. Ensures the health and safety of the project team and the respect of the environment Applies and respects the procedures of the engineering and plant sites and the responsibility for control or destruction of project parts and waste. Customer Is OP's accountable representative of the project for the customer With the support of the PQL ensures the actions of the customer APQP process and final customer validation files (PPAP, PSW...) are cascaded and managed through the project team. Responsible for the coordination / management of all the project team members' communications to the customer and ensure the core team members take their responsibility in front of the customer. Is responsible for ensuring that all the customer deliverables (customer approval, APQP, build deliveries etc.) are managed and delivered by the project team and reports the progress to the customer in line with the agreed Statement Of Work. Identifies to the Commercial Project Manager and the customer, customer scope changes to the agreed Customer Statement of Work in accordance to the budget of development (hours, travel costs, costs / hour) and the OPTIMAP project plan. Supports the Commercial Project Manager in the negotiation of customer scope changes. Department Participates in the establishment and the delivery of the department progress plans Participates in the continuous improvement of the departments, organization and methodologies, with actions of lessons learned, best practices and productivity. Cascading / be a mentor for another junior program manager.

At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward.

Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You'll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow's automotive industry.

Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions.

With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R& D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

title: Regional finance manager, latin america
description:
Heidrick & Struggles is the world’s foremost advisor on executive leadership, driving superior client performance through premier human capital leadership advisory services. For more than 70 years, we’ve delivered value for our clients by leveraging unrivaled expertise to help organizations discover and enable outstanding leaders and teams. Learn more at

Job Description:

Who we Are

Heidrick & Struggles is a premier provider of global leadership advisory and on-demand talent solutions, serving the senior-level talent and consulting needs of the world's top organizations. In our role as trusted leadership advisors, we partner with our clients to develop future-ready leaders and organizations, bringing together our services and offerings in executive search, diversity and inclusion, leadership assessment and development, organization and team acceleration, culture shaping and on-demand, independent talent solutions. Heidrick & Struggles pioneered the profession of executive search more than 70 years ago. Today, the firm provides integrated talent and human capital solutions to help our clients change the world, one leadership team at a time.®

Additional information on the firm can be found at .

The Role

The Regional Finance Manager - Latin America (RFD) oversees the financial activities for the Latin America region, encompassing five offices across three countries which generate revenue more than USD 20 M. The position reports directly to the Global Finance Director for Executive Search (GFD) and partners closely with the Latin America Regional Leader (RL) and the region’s operational management team. This role plays an integral part in the company’s strategic direction, development, and future growth in the region and serves as the primary finance liaison to field operational teams.

Responsibilities : Lead and develop the Latin America Finance teams, ensuring high performance, engagement, and robust succession planning. Oversee Latin America financial assurance, the control environment, operational analysis, and recurring financial and business processes with an investment and value-creation orientation. Develop an intimate understanding of the regional business, its key drivers, and market dynamics, maintaining strong working relationships at all levels of operations. Drive annual planning and forecasting processes to deliver office and practice budgets, as well as strategic plans that enhance regional success, growth, and profitability, in collaboration with corporate and operational teams. Manage monthly and quarterly detailed financial reviews and management reporting packages to measure historical and current performance, providing clear insight and recommendations. Generate and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability across the region. Create analyses and financial models to support regional growth initiatives, new investments, strategic and operational efforts, and to enable improved financial decision-making and sustainable performance improvement. Use management information and KPIs to provide insight into trends that support the effective running of the region and drive continuous improvement. Prepare presentations and supporting financial analysis and materials for leadership team meetings and regional reviews, as required. Approve and manage regional expenditure budgets, ensuring disciplined cost management and alignment with strategic priorities. Review and approve commercial Terms & Conditions for new business assignments, including margin expectations and risk considerations. Own externally facing finance and operational components across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, including vendor relationships, leases, facilities obligations, landlord negotiations, benefits vendors, and other locally administered commercial matters, ensuring appropriate oversight, cost control, approval discipline, and escalation visibility. Collaborate closely with regional finance leaders and accounting teams in other geographies to ensure alignment of financial strategies, policies, and operational goals. Oversee locally administered payroll, consultant compensation, bonus accruals, statutory accounting, tax provisions, cash and intercompany activity, and related accounting entries, partnering with local tax, accounting, banking, legal, and labor compliance advisors to ensure alignment with US GAAP, statutory requirements, corporate policy, and local regulations.

Required Qualifications: Undergraduate degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, with a strong record of academic achievement. Minimum of five (5) years of corporate finance experience, demonstrating increasing levels of responsibility and scope. Proven track record operating as a trusted finance business partner to senior leadership. Intelligent and highly creative individual, at ease interacting with executive decision makers and discussing the pros and cons of project alternatives as a respectful, equal participant. Strong sense of how businesses operate in a global context and the ability to bring a macro perspective to business opportunities and regional decisions. Demonstrated project management expertise, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion. Fluency in English and at least one major Latin American language (Portuguese and/or Spanish). Recognizes trends and events outside the organization and focuses the organization’s financial, operational and human capital on the issues that affect performance. Superior analytical skills balanced by a keen ability to integrate the larger strategic picture, rapidly understand and explain complex issues in simple terms, and develop a range of potential solutions. Develops and applies creative solutions to business problems, anticipates situations and needs, finds flexible answers to new situations, and champions innovation to improve business performance. Forms networks of positive business relationships that enhance personal and business success. Partners with colleagues across all departments, service lines, and other regions as one team to ensure a successful outcome for the firm. A well-balanced individual defined not only as smart, but pragmatic. An outstanding communicator with excellent negotiation skills who will be viewed as a team player, with the ability to build a network of support from people at both corporate and business unit levels. Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects with an ability to drive successful outcomes with a shared commitment among a diverse team. Ability to work with the senior leadership of the Company as a peer, and to be perceived as a valuable business partner. A self-starter who is one step ahead while ensuring that others on the team are not left behind. Able to position and coach others to achieve industry-leading standards. Strong work ethic and unquestionable integrity.

Preferred Qualifications: Chartered Accountant qualification; part-qualified accountants will be considered. Strong understanding of Latin America taxation and regulatory frameworks. Professional services sector experience; direct industry experience in executive search is not required. Additional language skills beyond English and Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Heidrick & Struggles is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, veteran or military status, or citizenship status.

title: Bim engineer- mechanical
description:
About CTS Group

CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data centre

development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data centre solutions.

With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a culture of innovation,

collaboration, and excellence — combining engineering expertise with manufacturing capability to deliver high-performance, sustainable data centre solutions at speed and scale.

With a proven track record and strong partnerships, CTS is a trusted leader in delivering large-scale, complex data centre facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence.

Role Overview

The BIM Mechanical Engineer supports the development, coordination, and delivery of mechanical (HVAC, cooling, piping) BIM/Revit models for hyperscale and colocation data centre projects. Working within CTS's São Paulo engineering hub, the role bridges mechanical engineering knowledge with BIM modelling and coordination practice — ensuring mechanical models are accurate, clash-free, and aligned with project standards, client requirements, and applicable codes. The scope and level of ownership vary by experience band, from supporting model development under supervision (Junior), to owning mechanical model delivery end-to-end (Intermediate), to defining BIM strategy and holding technical sign-off authority for the mechanical discipline (Senior).

This is an opportunity to build specialist expertise in mechanical BIM coordination within a fast-track, multidisciplinary project environment, alongside experienced engineers across CTS's global project portfolio.

Responsibilities : Develop and maintain coordinated mechanical BIM/Revit models covering HVAC, cooling, piping, ductwork, and associated plant systems from concept through IFC and as-built stages. Produce mechanical drawings, schematics, equipment layouts, ductwork and pipe routing, schedules, quantities, and model-based deliverables. Perform or support clash detection and multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or equivalent common data environments. Coordinate mechanical model interfaces with electrical, structural, architectural, vendor, and OEM stakeholders to achieve accurate, constructible, clash-free outputs. Develop and maintain model content in accordance with the BIM Execution Plan, level of detail/information requirements, naming conventions, ISO 19650 principles, and project quality standards. Support the selection, sizing, layout, and BIM integration of mechanical equipment such as chillers, CRAHs, AHUs, pumps, CDUs, and heat-rejection systems, according to role capability. Review or support the review of vendor and OEM technical submittals, equipment data, and model content for BIM integration. Prepare model views, clash reports, bills of quantities, material take-offs, equipment schedules, RFIs, technical submittals, and other engineering documentation. Participate in model audits, integrated design reviews, coordination meetings, technical workshops, site-query resolution, and commissioning activities. Contribute to continuous improvement of mechanical BIM standards, digital workflows, model quality, and team capability; guide colleagues where appropriate.

Você será a ponte entre as áreas usuárias e o time de desenvolvimento, sendo responsável por entender a necessidade, questionar o processo, avaliar o que o sistema já oferece e, quando necessário, estruturar o requisito para evolução do sistema.

⚠️ Importante: não buscamos necessariamente um programador. É fundamental, porém, compreender lógica de programação e ADVPL para conseguir conversar tecnicamente com desenvolvedores, questionar soluções e garantir que o desenvolvimento realmente atenda à necessidade do negócio.

Principais responsabilidades

• Mapear, analisar e redesenhar processos industriais e corporativos;

• Identificar gargalos, oportunidades de automação, inovação e melhoria contínua;

• Levantar e estruturar requisitos junto às áreas de negócio;

• Atuar como ponte entre usuários, processos, TI e desenvolvimento;

• Identificar oportunidades utilizando recursos já existentes no Protheus;

• Avaliar quando uma demanda pode ser resolvida por parametrização, melhoria de processo ou desenvolvimento;

• Elaborar e acompanhar requisitos para evolução do sistema;

• Compreender e questionar tecnicamente soluções desenvolvidas em ADVPL ;

• Mapear processos utilizando BPM/BPMN , preferencialmente Bizagi;

• Construir fluxos AS IS e TO BE ;

• Participar de homologações, testes e implantação de melhorias;

• Analisar impactos das alterações sistêmicas nos processos;

• Propor soluções inovadoras e novas formas de utilização dos recursos tecnológicos existentes.

Formação

Superior completo em áreas como:

• Engenharia de Produção;

• Engenharia de Processos/Industrial;

• Sistemas de Informação;

• Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;

• Ciência da Computação;

• Engenharia de Software;

• Administração ou áreas correlatas.

O que precisamos encontrar no seu perfil

✔ Experiência com mapeamento e melhoria de processos ;

✔ Vivência em ambiente industrial/fabril ;

✔ Experiência com TOTVS Protheus ;

✔ Conhecimento de processos industriais, como produção, PCP, estoque, custos, compras, qualidade ou áreas relacionadas;

✔ Conhecimento em levantamento e análise de requisitos;

✔ Conhecimento em SQL Server/banco de dados ;

✔ Conhecimento em lógica de programação e capacidade de interpretar ADVPL ;

✔ Capacidade de conversar tecnicamente com desenvolvimento;

✔ Perfil analítico, investigativo e questionador;

✔ Visão macro do negócio sem perder a capacidade de análise detalhada.

⭐ Será diferencial:

• Bizagi/BPMN;

• Lean Manufacturing / Lean Six Sigma;

• Melhoria contínua;

• Projetos de transformação digital;

• Integrações e APIs;

• Experiência com implantação/evolução do Protheus;

• Experiência com PCP e manufatura;

• Vivência em indústria têxtil, confecção ou vestuário;

• Conhecimento mais aprofundado em ADVPL;

• Gestão de projetos/metodologias ágeis.

Informações da oportunidade

Local: Maranguape/CE – Região Metropolitana de Fortaleza

Modelo: 100% presencial

Horário: a definir

Remuneração: a definir, conforme pretensão e experiência profissional

Quem estamos procurando?

Uma pessoa que não se limite a receber demandas.

Queremos alguém que pergunte:

"Por que fazemos dessa forma?"

"O Protheus já possui uma solução para isso?"

"Podemos melhorar o processo antes de desenvolver?"

"Essa customização realmente resolve o problema?"

"Qual será o impacto dessa alteração nas demais áreas?"

Se você gosta de processos + indústria + tecnologia + Protheus + inovação , e tem perfil para conectar o negócio ao desenvolvimento, queremos conhecer você!

title: Hr intern
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from a global network of vendors, all at affordable prices.

Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on-demand production methodology for a smarter, future-ready industry.

Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world and continues to expand globally.

Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Human Resources Intern will support the SA Fulfillment HRBP team in several HR activities, including onboarding, employee engagement, internal communications, training support, and HRBP routines.

This role is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in different areas of Human Resources while working closely with experienced HRBP professionals in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, supporting over 200 employees.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about HR, eager to learn, proactive, and interested in building a long-term career in the field.

This role will be based in São Paulo.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Support new hire onboarding activities, including system access, HR Hub announcements, and welcome initiatives; Assist in the planning and execution of employee engagement initiatives and events; Help design and manage the Monthly Engagement Calendar; Support internal communications by drafting announcements, creating content, and updating HR Hub publications; Assist with the organization of key meetings and HR routines; Support training activities, including attendance tracking, feedback collection, and post-training reports; Maintain and update HR documents, reports, and trackers to ensure information is accurate and up to date; Support the HRBP team with ad-hoc HR projects and basic data analysis as needed.

REQUIREMENTS

Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree; Strong interest in Human Resources; Fluent in English and Portuguese; Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, Power Point, and Word; Strong sense of responsibility and ownership; Proactive attitude, with willingness to learn and take initiative; Fast learner, with ability to adapt to a dynamic environment; Good communication and organizational skills; Positive attitude and ability to work well in a multicultural team. Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree, with expected conclusion at December, 2027 or after.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and respected.

All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community, and all types of diversity.

title: Analista fiscal (j1btax)
description:
A Bravo atua na gestão de processos de back-office, com ênfase nas áreas tributária e financeira, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas e serviços de BPO por meio de um centro de excelência reconhecido pelo alto padrão de qualidade e performance.

Nosso compromisso é construir parcerias estratégicas com nossos clientes, indo além de uma relação de fornecimento para promover, em conjunto, inovação, eficiência operacional e resultados sustentáveis.

Com mais de uma década de experiência, combinamos conhecimento técnico, relacionamento próximo e tecnologia de ponta para simplificar processos complexos, assegurar a conformidade fiscal e contribuir para o crescimento dos negócios.

Nossa singularidade está no desenvolvimento de soluções ágeis, inteligentes e personalizadas, apoiadas pela nossa fábrica de software própria, a Bravo Labs. Além disso, contamos com parcerias homologadas com grandes empresas, como a Thomson Reuters, garantindo a operação em plataformas líderes de mercado.

Venha fazer a diferença com a Bravo!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Fiscal Sênior, com sólida experiência em rotinas fiscais, conhecimento avançado em SAP e atuação com a solução J1 BTax. Procuramos um profissional analítico, comprometido com a excelência operacional e com capacidade para atuar em processos tributários complexos, contribuindo para a conformidade e a melhoria contínua das operações.

Principais responsabilidades

Atuar na execução, análise e revisão de processos fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações tributárias e dos procedimentos internos; Realizar a apuração e conferência de tributos diretos e indiretos, conforme a legislação vigente; Atuar nos processos fiscais dentro do SAP, incluindo análise de documentos, lançamentos, parametrizações e integrações; Utilizar e apoiar a administração da solução J1 BTax, garantindo a correta aplicação das regras fiscais e tributárias; Analisar documentos fiscais, impostos, retenções, bases de cálculo, alíquotas e classificações fiscais; Realizar conciliações entre as informações fiscais, contábeis e financeiras; Apoiar a emissão, validação e correção de documentos fiscais eletrônicos; Acompanhar rejeições, inconsistências e erros de integração entre SAP, J1 BTax e demais sistemas envolvidos; Identificar riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e impactos decorrentes de alterações na legislação tributária; Apoiar a elaboração, validação e entrega de obrigações acessórias; Elaborar relatórios, indicadores e análises gerenciais relacionados aos processos fiscais; Atender auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações e solicitações de clientes; Elaborar e manter documentações, procedimentos e controles internos; Atuar em projetos de melhoria contínua, automação e otimização dos processos fiscais; Prestar suporte técnico às áreas internas, clientes e demais envolvidos nos processos tributários; Orientar e apoiar profissionais de menor senioridade, compartilhando conhecimento técnico e boas práticas. Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas; Experiência sólida na área fiscal, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos, consultorias ou operações de BPO; Conhecimento avançado em SAP, especialmente nos processos relacionados à área fiscal; Experiência com J1 BTax; Conhecimento em apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos; Domínio de obrigações acessórias e documentos fiscais eletrônicos; Conhecimento da legislação tributária brasileira; Experiência com conciliações fiscais e contábeis; Excel intermediário ou avançado; Capacidade de interpretar dados, identificar inconsistências e propor soluções.

Diferenciais

Experiência com implantação, parametrização ou sustentação do SAP e J1 BTax; Conhecimento em SAP S/4 HANA; Experiência com Thomson Reuters e demais soluções fiscais; Vivência em projetos de automação e transformação digital na área tributária; Conhecimento em Power BI ou outras ferramentas de análise de dados; Pós-graduação em Gestão Tributária, Controladoria, Contabilidade ou áreas afins; Inglês técnico.

Competências comportamentais

Visão analítica, crítica e orientada à solução; Organização e atenção aos detalhes; Comunicação clara e capacidade de apresentar informações técnicas; Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e hands on; Proatividade e autonomia; Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e múltiplas demandas; Facilidade para atuar em equipe e interagir com diferentes áreas; Comprometimento com a qualidade e a conformidade; Curiosidade e interesse por tecnologia e inovação; Capacidade de orientar e desenvolver outros profissionais; Adaptabilidade a mudanças e novos processos.

Área de atuação

Fiscal | Tributária | Tecnologia Fiscal | SAP e J1 BTax

Informações complementares

Modelo de contratação: via cooperativa; Atuação em ambiente corporativo, tecnológico e orientado à melhoria contínua; Oportunidade de participação em projetos estratégicos de transformação e eficiência fiscal. Modelo híbrido na região de Pinheiros/SP.

title: Arquiteto de soluções
description:
Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções / Desenvolvedor AWS para fazer parte do time!

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor / Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software e atuação comprovada no desenho de arquiteturas de soluções AWS. O foco principal é construir, evoluir e sustentar aplicações em produção, combinando qualidade de código, visão arquitetural e domínio prático de cloud.

Este profissional atuará de forma hands-on em decisões de arquitetura, implementação de componentes críticos, integração de serviços AWS, automação de infraestrutura, observabilidade, segurança, confiabilidade e otimização de custos.

A função é de contribuição individual e não inclui responsabilidade formal de Tech Lead ou gestão de pessoas. Experiência em discovery, pré-vendas e comunicação técnica com clientes será valorizada como diferencial e utilizada pontualmente.

Desenvolvimento de software

• Projetar, desenvolver, testar, revisar e manter aplicações, APIs, microsserviços, integrações e componentes críticos em produção.

• Aplicar clean code, SOLID, design patterns, tratamento de erros, testes automatizados, segurança e documentação.

• Atuar com Python, Node.js, Type Script, Go ou linguagem equivalente, demonstrando profundidade em pelo menos uma stack de produção.

• Realizar code reviews, troubleshooting e análise de performance, contribuindo tecnicamente com o time sem assumir liderança formal de pessoas.

• Modernizar aplicações legadas e avaliar a adoção pragmática de serverless, containers, microsserviços e eventos.

Arquitetura de soluções

• Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções seguras, escaláveis, resilientes, observáveis e financeiramente sustentáveis.

• Criar diagramas de contexto, componentes, sequência, integração, dados, rede, segurança e implantação com ícones AWS, C4, UML ou notação equivalente.

• Registrar decisões com Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), incluindo contexto, alternativas, trade-offs e consequências.

• Definir disponibilidade, capacidade, latência, escalabilidade, RTO, RPO, backup, disaster recovery e prontidão para produção.

• Avaliar serviços e revisar soluções com base no AWS Well-Architected Framework, equilibrando operação, segurança, confiabilidade, performance, custo e sustentabilidade.

• Construir provas de conceito e apoiar o detalhamento técnico e o handoff das soluções.

Cloud, Dev Ops e operação

• Implementar infraestrutura com Terraform, módulos reutilizáveis, gestão de estado, pipelines e controles para Infrastructure as Code.

• Criar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD, testes automatizados, controles Dev Sec Ops e estratégias seguras de deployment e rollback.

• Implementar observabilidade com logs, métricas, traces, alarmes, dashboards e SLI/SLO.

• Investigar incidentes e falhas complexas, participar de análise de causa raiz e implementar ações preventivas.

• Aplicar segurança por design, least privilege, gestão de segredos, criptografia, proteção de perímetro e rastreabilidade.

• Otimizar continuamente custo, performance, capacidade e confiabilidade.

Apoio técnico a clientes e pré-vendas - Desejável

• Participar pontualmente de discovery técnico, workshops, estimativas, provas de conceito e apresentações para clientes.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em alternativas técnicas, premissas, riscos, estimativas de esforço e custos AWS.

• Explicar decisões e trade-offs com clareza para públicos técnicos, executivos e comerciais.

• Apoiar respostas a RFPs, RFIs e questionários técnicos ou de segurança quando necessário.

Serviços e Conhecimentos Relevantes

Desenvolvimento e arquitetura

APIs REST/Graph QL, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, serverless, eventos, cache, consistência, idempotência e resiliência.

Computação

EC2, Auto Scaling, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, ECR, containers e seleção entre compute gerenciado, serverless e Kubernetes.

Redes e entrega

VPC, subnets, Security Groups, Route 53, ELB, Cloud Front, API Gateway, Private Link, Transit Gateway, VPN e conectividade híbrida.

Dados e integração

S3, RDS/Aurora, Dynamo DB, Elasti Cache, SQS, SNS, Event Bridge, Step Functions, Kinesis ou MSK; Glue, Athena e Redshift como diferenciais.

Segurança e identidade

IAM, IAM Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, ACM, WAF, Shield, Cloud Trail, AWS Config, Guard Duty, Security Hub e least privilege.

Governança

AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs, landing zones, contas multi-account, tagging, políticas e segregação de ambientes.

Observabilidade e resiliência

Cloud Watch, X-Ray/Open Telemetry, logs, métricas, traces, AWS Backup, alta disponibilidade, RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação.

Automação e entrega

Terraform, módulos, state, pipelines Ia C, Git, CI/CD, testes, deployment, Systems Manager e noções de Cloud Formation ou CDK.

Fin Ops e IA

Cost Explorer, Budgets, Compute Optimizer, Savings Plans e alocação de custos; Bedrock, RAG, agentes e guardrails como diferenciais.

Profundidade Esperada

Espera-se domínio prático de desenvolvimento de software e conhecimento aprofundado em pelo menos quatro dos domínios AWS acima. Não é necessário dominar todos os serviços, mas é essencial selecionar alternativas, explicar trade-offs e implementar soluções sustentáveis em produção.

Competências Comportamentais

• Comunicação oral e escrita clara, objetiva e adaptada a públicos técnicos, executivos, comerciais e clientes.

• Pensamento sistêmico para equilibrar qualidade, prazo, segurança, risco, operação e custo.

• Autonomia, pragmatismo, colaboração e forte senso de ownership sobre entregas e resultados.

• Capacidade de trabalhar com ambiguidades, investigar problemas complexos e tomar decisões fundamentadas.

• Abertura a feedback, disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e maturidade para discutir alternativas técnicas.

• Orientação ao cliente e compreensão do impacto das escolhas técnicas no negócio.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência relevante com desenvolvimento de aplicações em produção e atuação prática em AWS.

• Experiência comprovada desenhando ou participando ativamente de arquiteturas de soluções AWS.

• Profundidade em Python, Node.js/Type Script, Go ou linguagem equivalente, incluindo testes e práticas de qualidade.

• Experiência com APIs, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, serverless ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

• Experiência com Terraform, CI/CD, Git, containers, observabilidade e troubleshooting em produção.

• Conhecimento de redes, segurança, alta disponibilidade, backup e recuperação de desastres na AWS.

• Capacidade de produzir diagramas, ADRs, documentação técnica e estimativas de implementação.

• Certificação AWS válida de nível Associate ou superior.

Vem fazer parte do time! Aguardamos a sua inscrição!!
